description: Open-roof bridge reconstruction from deck plan and cross-sections. Offset command axis, sunken well, perimeter stations, service ring and aft turbolift; approximate metre scale.

MK-IX hangar dollhouse from Deck 19 plan and port elevation. Six clamshell segments, galleries, paired control towers, landing target, elevator turntable and Deck 20 shop section. Approximate dimensions; doors posed partly open.

Impulse power unit IP186E/2-IR reconstructed from three views. Stated envelope 5.2 × 4.5 × 2.8 m; twelve circulation tubes, twin firing chambers, feed chute and five heat-exchanger connections. Undimensioned recess depths are interpreted.
